Grand Theft Auto 6 was designed to maximise fidelity in both graphics and simulation for current generation consoles and the trade-off was that 60fps was not possible, meaning a game that targets 30fps instead. In this video, Oliver isolates specific scenarios that push GTA 6's systems to the limit, demonstrating not only that 60fps is completely off the table for current generation hardware - but also that 40fps probably isn't viable either.
